title: Minimax Regret for Personalized Continuous-Dose Rules under Vanishing Assignment Density
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=subfield < floor=field (target=field) and NOT salvageable in scope; paper_score_ceiling=7.3 < ceiling_for_field=7.4.
gap_reasons: The minimax characterization is incomplete on the strict threshold face.

The matched results otherwise concern a narrow one-dimensional class with uniform covariates, an exact common polynomial density exponent, strong concavity, tailored anisotropic smoothness, and an assumed Lipschitz oracle.
These scope restrictions, the unclassified face, and the absence of computational or applied evidence constrain the projected leading-journal score despite the delivered matched rates.
The headline novelty positioning does not give a relevance/comparison sentence for every bibliography entry.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived matched weak-boundary regret n^{-4/(κ+9)}, a range-free adaptive learner, an interior n^{-4/9} phase, a quadratic n^{-2/3} face, and a zero-regret endpoint. The math referee passed, but the novelty gate capped the package at subfield, below the fixed field floor. The strict λμ=4B_Y transition face, broader-model evidence, and targeted literature comparisons remain for a future re-raise.
tldr: For one-Lipschitz personalized continuous-dose rules, polynomial loss of assignment density at zero yields the matched boundary rate \(n^{-4/(\kappa+9)}\), attained without knowing \(\kappa\) or a compact exponent endpoint and without a nonconstant adaptation penalty. Bounded outcomes create three additional geometries: strict interior oracles have rate \(n^{-4/9}\); zero curvature or smoothness slack forces an exactly quadratic dose response and rate \(n^{-2/3}\); and the terminal equality \(\lambda_\mu=16B_Y\) forces the known oracle \(x\mapsto1/2\), so minimax regret is exactly zero. Only the strict threshold face \(\lambda_\mu=4B_Y<\min\{\Lambda_\mu,M_\mu\}\) remains unclassified, while the exact-domain adaptive boundary upper bound remains valid there. A separate policy bridge converts every observed-law regret statement into causal welfare regret.
gap: Published continuous-treatment policy guarantees impose a conditional density bounded away from zero, while weak-overlap all-learner converses concern binary decisions.  Degenerate random-design theory does not incorporate covariate-indexed constrained policy optimization.
fill: The project first characterizes the exact nonempty radius domain and isolates the stricter radius slack needed for boundary-approaching optimizers.  It then derives a log-free integrated random-design Gram lemma, proves stability and measurability of an endpoint-valid Lipschitz quadratic-program learner, and constructs a same-class affine two-point Bernoulli Assouad hypercube with neighbor divergence \(n\varepsilon^2B_Y^{-2}h^{\kappa+9}\).  The polynomial-thinning law, tailored anisotropic response smoothness, and unit-Lipschitz oracle path are explicit maintained restrictions with concrete diagnostics or examples, rather than consequences of the comparator literature.
